usage:
Usage: zaprett <command> [arguments] [--json] [--lang ru|en|zh-CN]

Service:
  status                          state
  start | stop | restart          engine control
  enable | disable                turn on/off (autostart)
  check                           validate settings without starting
Lists and strategies:
  items [--type <type>]           installed items
  list enable|disable <id>        turn a list on/off
  strategy set|show <id>          select / show a strategy
  strategy save <id> < file       save your own strategy (id starts with user-)
  strategy delete <id>            delete your strategy
  user get <id> | user set <id> < file   your own list
  mode whitelist|blacklist        list mode
  engine winws|winws2             engine
Repository and subscriptions:
  repo fetch | repo list [--type <type>] | repo install <id>... | repo remove <id> | repo upgrade [--all | <id>...]
  sources list | sources update [<name>...] | sources save <name> < json | sources delete <name> | sources defaults
Quick setup and automatic selection:
  presets | wizard apply <service>[:<variant>]...
  test start [--strategies id,id] [--quick] [--apply-if-better] [--exclusive] | test status [--brief] | test stop | test apply <id>
Checks and monitoring:
  probe [--services id,id] | probe status
  monitor run | monitor status
  diagnose [--services id,id] | diagnose status
  log [--tail N]                  service and engine log
  page overview|lists|strategies|diagnostics
  conflicts                       interfering software (WinDivert, GoodbyeDPI, VPN, proxy...)
DNS, settings, updates:
  dns status | dns setup | dns off   encrypted DNS: state / turn on / restore previous settings
  settings get | settings set < json
  update check | update install
Background jobs:
  job status | job log [--tail N] | job cancel
Other:
  version | diag [--full]

Flags: --json (JSON output), --quiet (no output on success), --lang (output language; default: ui.language from the settings)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 command failed, 2 invalid arguments, 3 service not available
input_not_json: Input must be a JSON object
unavailable: The zaprett service is not available (is the "zaprett" service running?): {0}
input_not_json_detail: Input must be a JSON object: {0}
